title: Towing Dispatch Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Towing Dispatch: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Towing Dispatch Inspection Checklist covers disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery. The towing dispatch coordinator records Towing Dispatch criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Towing Dispatch Inspection Checklist keeps Towing Dispatch exceptions visible until the towing dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Towing Dispatch Inspection Checklist at roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location. Document disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery identity before Towing Dispatch begins. Compare disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery findings with stated Towing Dispatch criteria; route unresolved Towing Dispatch issues to qualified towing operations reviewer. For Towing Dispatch Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Towing Dispatch. Ask qualified towing operations reviewer to review Towing Dispatch conditions beyond the towing dispatch coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Towing Dispatch, identify responsible parties, roadside pickup, safe staging point, tow route, storage yard, and delivery location, and the linked disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery source.

fields.label: Vehicle VIN or plate, make, model, color, and location
Truck, operator, equipment, destination, and custody references

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Towing Dispatch facts for disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Towing Dispatch inspection checks
items: Road, traffic, weather, visibility, and scene safety
Vehicle position, damage, mobility, drivetrain, and clearance
Tow method, attachment, securement, and special equipment
Occupant, key, property, and law-enforcement context
Departure, route, storage, and destination handoff

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Towing Dispatch, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Towing Dispatch Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Vehicle requires different equipment or recovery plan
blocks.guidance: Pause Towing Dispatch when scene safety, authority, equipment fit, securement, destination, or vehicle custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Towing Dispatch proof and route unresolved disabled vehicle, requester, pickup condition, destination, tow equipment, route, custody, and delivery scope to towing dispatch coordinator.
